name: MKT_SEM_AD_RESULTS
description: This table will be used to store SEM Ad Results.Total impressions, click and such other data about individual Search Engine Marketing ads.

columns.name: AD_ID
columns.description: Ad ID generated on Fusion side. This is different than the vendor ad id.

columns.name: VENDOR_AD_ID
columns.description: AD ID as provided by SEM Vendor

columns.name: ADGROUP_ID
columns.description: Ad group ID that this AD is associated with.

columns.name: CONNECTIONID
columns.description: Connection ID. This is the connection ID under which the AD is created.

columns.name: CAMPAIGN_ID
columns.description: Campaign ID to which this AD is associated to.

columns.name: REPORTDATE
columns.description: Report date for this particular ad against which the stats will be reported.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of a given ad as provided by SEM Vendor.

columns.name: IMPRESSIONS
columns.description: Impressions for a ad on a given report date.

columns.name: CLICKS
columns.description: Clicks  for a ad on a given report date.

columns.name: CTR
columns.description: Click Thru Rate  for a ad on a given report date.

columns.name: AVGCPC
columns.description: Average cost per click  for a ad on a given report date.

columns.name: COST
columns.description: Cost associated  for a ad on a given report date.

columns.name: AVGPOSITION
columns.description: 'Average position' is a statistic attributed to each of your ad. It refers to the average position on a search result page that an ad appears in when it's triggered by that keyword.

columns.name: CURRENCY
columns.description: Currency associated with a given ad.

columns.name: AVGCPM
columns.description: It's your average cost of 1000 impressions for your ad group or search keyword.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_LINE1
columns.description: The text that will be included in line 1 of the advertisement.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_LINE2
columns.description: The text that will be included in line 2 of the advertisement.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION_LINE3
columns.description: The text that will be included in line 3 of the advertisement.

columns.name: DESTINATION_URL
columns.description: Destination URL (if any) associated with a given ad.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
